goal: Prove opt-in Rust cuda-oxide packed Q8 dequantization and activation quantization kernels without claiming quantized matmul or route behavior.

cuda_oxide.module_form: executable-local #[cuda_module] with packed 34-byte Q8 blocks and libdevice-linked nearest-even quantization

covered_behavior: dequant_q8_0_to_f16_kernel packed scale and signed-value expansion
dequant_q8_0_to_f32_kernel packed scale and signed-value expansion
quantize_q8_0_f32_kernel blockwise activation scale, lrintf-compatible rounding, and partial-block zero padding
excluded_behavior: matmul_q8_0 prequantized, warp, paired, batched, or HC-expansion kernels
Q8 matmul dispatch, runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, and C CUDA removal

not_claimed_in_this_stage: Q8 quantized matmul kernels or their dispatch policy
runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, or C CUDA removal
